parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy (ג'ימי) is offering 1 Wood for 1 Ore. Looking at the game state, Jimmy has 3 VP and needs Ore/Wheat for cities or development cards. I currently have 1 Sheep, 1 Ore, 1 Wood, and 1 Wheat. My immediate goal is a settlement at N51, which requires 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I already have Wood, Wheat, and Sheep. Trading away my only Ore for more Wood doesn't help me get the Brick I need, and it actively helps Jimmy (the leader) toward a city. I will reject this trade.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's Wood for Ore trade. Jimmy is at 3 VP and likely looking for Ore to build a city. I still need 1 Brick for the settlement at N51.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, אבן זה מצרך יקר מדי כרגע, במיוחד כשיש לך כבר 3 נקודות. אני צריכה את האבן שלי לעצמי.
